entities.name: Query pinoresinol reductase
observations: 330 aa soluble NADPH-dependent reductase sequence; exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt E6Y2X0.
Predicted Pfam domains: NmrA (residues 21–326), Epimerase (24–131), and NAD_binding_10 (28–176).
Likely dimer based on exact curated reference annotation.

entities.name: E6Y2X0
observations: Reviewed Linum usitatissimum bifunctional pinoresinol-lariciresinol reductase 2; exact sequence hash match to the query.
Catalyzes enantioselective reduction of (+)-pinoresinol to (+)-lariciresinol and (+)-lariciresinol to (-)-secoisolariciresinol.
Uses the 4R hydride of NADPH; EC 1.23.1.1 and EC 1.23.1.2; dimeric.

entities.name: Pinoresinol to lariciresinol
observations: (+)-pinoresinol + NADPH + H(+) -> (+)-lariciresinol + NADP(+). Reverse database equation is listed as RHEA:34419.
The reaction is an enantioselective lignan-benzylic ether reduction.

entities.name: Lariciresinol to secoisolariciresinol
observations: (+)-lariciresinol + NADPH + H(+) -> (-)-secoisolariciresinol + NADP(+). Reverse database equation is listed as RHEA:34423.
The reaction is the second sequential enantioselective reduction in lignan biosynthesis.

entities.name: NADPH
observations: The reductase abstracts the 4R hydride from NADPH during catalysis.

entities.name: Lignan biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme participates in lignan biosynthesis, producing lariciresinol and secoisolariciresinol intermediates.
